description: This file defines the FavoritesController class which handles HTTP requests related to favoriting articles in an ASP.NET Core application. It provides endpoints for adding and removing favorites by article slug, utilizing MediatR for request handling and enforcing authorization with JWT schemes.

classes.name: FavoritesController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling favorite/unfavorite article requests.

methods.name: FavoriteAdd
methods.description: Handles POST request to add an article to favorites.

methods.name: FavoriteDelete
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove an article from favorites.
